title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) not expected to return in Week 6
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters he does not expect Christian Kirk to return next week.
items.impact: The 49ers wide receiver got even more banged up in Sunday's win over the Seahawks. It appears they'll have to wait at least one more week for the return of Kirk.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Yannick Ngakoue to workout for Giants Monday
items.desc: The Giants will host former Pro Bowl DE Yannick Ngakoue for a workout on Monday.
items.impact: Ngakoue sat out last season to recover and is now fully healthy. He is looking to make his comeback.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonah Savaiinaea suffers ankle injury Sunday
items.desc: Jonah Savaiinaea suffered an ankle injury in Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Savaiinaea will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) 'may miss some time'
items.desc: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said David Montgomery may miss "some time."
items.impact: Montgomery left Sunday's game early and did not return. It would make sense for him to miss the next two weeks before potentially returning in Week 9 after the Texans bye. Woody Marks will be an RB2 for fantasy managers with Montgomery sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Campbell suffers knee sprain
items.desc: Patriots OT Will Campbell is believed to have suffered a knee sprain.
items.impact: Campbell will undergo an MRI on Monday, but he is expected to miss some time. There should be an update on a potential timetable for his return early in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jermaine Eluemunor suffers calf injury Sunday
items.desc: Jermaine Eluemunor suffered a calf injury in Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Eluemunor was feeling better post-game. He'll continue to be monitored throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javon Hargrave believed to have suffered Achilles tendon rupture
items.desc: Packers DT Javon Hargrave is believed to have suffered an Achilles tendon rupture in Week 5 against the Bears.
items.impact: LB Edgerrin Cooper just suffered the same injury last week for the Packers defense. It is another brutal break for them defensively.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devin White (forearm) expected to require surgery
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said LB Devin White is "probably going to need surgery" after fracturing his forearm in Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: White will miss some time. He could be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. suffers rib injury Sunday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. left Sunday's game late against the Ravens.
items.impact: Penix took a brutal hit to the midsection late in the fourth quarter. It led to Tua Tagovailoa taking the field in the overtime period. Penix will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) not expected to return in Week 6
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said he does not plan to play Zach Charbonnet in Week 6 against the Broncos.
items.impact: That was the expectation with it being a short week for Seattle. Charbonnet should return in Week 7 against the Chiefs. It will be one more game of Emanuel Wilson leading the Seahawks backfield on Thursday against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seahawks D/ST impresses despite final score Sunday
items.desc: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 25 points on 269 total yards with one interception, two fumble recoveries and three sacks on Sunday against the 49ers.
items.impact: While San Francisco scored 32 points, 7 points came off a fumble by George Holani recovered in the end zone for a touchdown. San Francisco also scored two other touchdowns in the first half off short field from two other turnovers in the first half. They'll face Bo Nix in Denver on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Myers has big day Sunday
items.desc: Jason Myers connected on 5-of-5 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: The Seahawks struggled to put the ball in the end zone on Sunday, which Myers took advantage of. He is now 10-of-10 on field goal attempts on the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Barner catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: AJ Barner caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: Barner remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp part of crazy ending Sunday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
items.impact: On 4th-and-10 with the game on the line, Kupp caught an 8-yard pass, made one defender miss and dove for the first down. After review, he wound up being short by one yard. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed caught 2-of-4 targets for 23 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: Shaheed remains off the fantasy radar in his current role. The Seahawks passing offense remains Jaxon Smith-Njigba or no one every week right now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has usual big day Sunday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 5-of-8 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba continues to dominate on a weekly basis. He did have a crucial third down drop in the Seahawks final drive that would have put them in field goal range.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Holani loses costly fumble Sunday
items.desc: George Holani ran for seven yards on four carries in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers on Sunday. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 24 yards receiving.
items.impact: Holani lost a costly fumble in his end zone in the final seconds of the first half. He remains well off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emanuel Wilson finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Emanuel Wilson ran for 61 yards and a touchdown on 20 carries in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 11 yards receiving.
items.impact: Wilson put the Seahawks on the board following a punt on a fumble return by Jacob Cowing. He also lost a fumble on the day. He'll likely remain an RB2 for one more week on Thursday against the Broncos before the likely return of Zach Charbonnet.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold struggles Sunday
items.desc: Sam Darnold completed 18-of-29 passes for 195 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: Darnold faced pressure all afternoon as he was sacked five times. He began both the game and second half with interceptions as well. He'll take on Denver on a short week on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: 49ers D/ST forces four turnovers Sunday
items.desc: The 49ers D/ST allowed 29 points on 251 total yards with two interceptions, two fumble recoveries and five sacks on Sunday against the Seahawks.
items.impact: San Francisco forced three turnovers in the first half, including a fumble recovery for a touchdown at the end of the first half. They'll take on Jayden Daniels and the Commanders next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eddy Pineiro hits go-ahead field goal Sunday
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro went 1-of-2 field goals and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Pineiro missed a field goal from 52 yards out to begin the second half. He made the one that went on to win the game for San Francisco just after the two-minute warning.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Kittle catches five passes Sunday
items.desc: George Kittle caught 5-of-6 targets for 24 yards in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
items.impact: Kittle was used as a dump off pass catcher from Brock Purdy all afternoon. He'll look to bounce back next week against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandin Cooks catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Brandin Cooks hauled in a seven-yard touchdown on Sunday against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Cooks took advantage of the opportunity with 49ers wide receivers going down with injuries. He could see some more opportunity heading into Week 6 against the Commanders, but he remains off the fantasy radar for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. suffers hamstring injury Sunday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. left Sunday's game early against the Seahawks with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Samuel was quickly ruled out after going down with a hamstring injury in the third quarter. His status for Week 6 is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans explodes for huge day Sunday
items.desc: Mike Evans caught 7-of-10 targets for 113 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday.
items.impact: In one drive alone to end the third quarter and start the fourth quarter, Evans caught four passes for big gains and the two point conversion after a touchdown. He'll be a strong WR2 play next week against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kaelon Black sees six carries Sunday
items.desc: Kaelon Black ran for 16 yards on six carries in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
items.impact: Black remains a pure stash for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian McCaffrey finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 15 yards receiving.
items.impact: McCaffrey continues to find the end zone to make up for his lack of yardage on the season. He scored right after a fumble by Emanuel Wilson this week. He remains an RB1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Purdy tosses two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Brock Purdy completed 19-of-29 passes for 189 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
items.impact: Purdy led two scoring drives on short field off two turnovers early in the game. He connected several times with Mike Evans late including a two-point conversion. He was sacked three times, the first time he had been taken to the ground all season. He draws a strong matchup next week against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Titans D/ST allows 26 points Sunday
items.desc: The Titans D/ST allowed 26 points on 329 total yards with two sacks on Sunday against the Texans.
items.impact: The Titans defense remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Slye makes lone field goal Sunday
items.desc: Joey Slye made his lone field goal on Sunday.
items.impact: Slye is not reliable for fantasy managers on the Titans offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gunnar Helm goes without catch Sunday
items.desc: Gunnar Helm did not catch his lone target in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: Helm remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Calvin Ridley totals 33 yards Sunday
items.desc: Calvin Ridley caught 2-of-3 targets for 33 yards in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans.
items.impact: Ridley remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson leads Titans in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 6-of-7 targets for 53 yards in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: Robinson posted his third game with 50 yards on the season. He remains a WR3/ flex play next week against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carnell Tate quiet Sunday
items.desc: Carnell Tate caught 1-of-5 targets for six yards in the Titans 26-3 loss on Sunday against the Texans.
items.impact: After a couple big performances, Tate was no where to be found this week. He'll be a WR3 play next week against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyjae Spears catches nine passes Sunday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears ran for zero yards on two carries in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans. He also caught 9-of-9 targets for 28 yards receiving.
items.impact: Spears was a safety blanket for Cam Ward out of the backfield all afternoon. He also lost a fumble. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard rushes for 52 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tony Pollard ran for 52 yards on 14 carries in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans.
items.impact: Pollard did not catch his lone target and didn't rip off longer than a 14-yard run. He'll remain a desperate RB2 play next week against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Ward struggles Sunday
items.desc: Cam Ward completed 23-of-36 passes for 170 yards with one interception in the Titans 26-3 loss on Sunday against the Texans.
items.impact: Ward and the Titans offense struggled to move the ball all afternoon after the first drive. He took four sacks and made several other moves to avoid what could have been more sacks. He'll take on the Colts next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Texans D/ST dominates Sunday
items.desc: The Texans D/ST allowed 3 points on 187 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and four sacks on Sunday against the Titans.
items.impact: The Texans defense looked at their best of the season on Sunday. They'll take on Trevor Lawrence and Jacksonville next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on four field goals Sunday
items.desc: Ka'imi Fairbairn made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 45, 35, 26 and 53 yards out all in the first half. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Schultz catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz caught 3-of-4 targets for 30 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Schultz remains closer to the TE2 range for fantasy managers with Nico Collins healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kayshon Boutte catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Kayshon Boutte caught 3-of-5 targets for 38 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Boutte remains off the fantasy radar in his current role, especially with the Texans trading for Marvin Harrison Jr.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylin Noel hauls in five passes Sunday
items.desc: Jaylin Noel caught 5-of-5 targets for 41 yards and a touchdown in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Noel tied Nico Collins for the team-high in receptions on the day. He has shown some flashes, but his role isn't consistent enough to put him on the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Hutchinson totals team-high 65 yards Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Hutchinson caught 4-of-5 targets for 65 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Hutchinson led Houston in receiving on the afternoon. He still remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins sees seven targets Sunday
items.desc: Nico Collins caught 5-of-7 targets for 56 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
items.impact: It wasn't a huge afternoon for Collins as Houston controlled the entire game. He will remain a WR1 next week against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Woody Marks sees 19 touches Sunday
items.desc: Woody Marks ran for 62 yards on 15 carries in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 23 yards receiving.
items.impact: Marks was the lead back for Houston most of the afternoon after David Montgomery injured his groin and did not return. He had a 20 yard touchdown taken off the board due to a holding penalty. He'll be an RB2 play next week against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Stroud totals two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 26-of-34 passes for  261 yards and one touchdown in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Stroud also added a rushing score at the goal line. He was able to take care of the ball in a game where the Texans defense dominated. He'll be a QB2 next week against the Jaguars.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jaylen Waddle does little with three touches in Week 5 win
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle caught only 2-of-5 targets for 19 yards and gained nine yards on one carry in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Waddle has been on a production rollercoaster over his first five games with the Broncos, reflecting the inconsistency of the Denver passing attack overall. After catching five passes and scoring his first touchdown of the season in Week 4, Waddle got very little done in Week 5. It's been frustrating for fantasy managers to this point, but Waddle is the clear No. 1 WR for the Broncos and the potential for big numbers is there.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Troy Franklin grabs two passes in Sunday's win
items.desc: Troy Franklin caught both of his targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: A week after not getting a single pass his way, Franklin came up with multiple catches for the first time this season in Sunday's win. Still, there was not much to see from the third-year pro. He's just not much of a factor in the struggling Denver passing game.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Courtland Sutton catches first touchdown of the season
items.desc: Courtland Sutton caught 2-of-3 targets for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Sutton found the end zone for the first time this season during Sunday's win, but the veteran receiver still hasn't really gotten going. Sutton has finished with three or fewer receptions in all five weeks so far. He's also topped out at 46 yards. Sutton cannot be relied upon for much fantasy production in the Broncos' lackluster passing attack right now.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Broncos defense delivers strong performance in Week 5 win
items.desc: The Broncos D/ST gave up 17 points on only 237 yards of total offense, racking up five sacks and forcing three turnovers in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: The Broncos came out the victors in this defensive battle on Sunday. One week after failing to record a single sack in a loss at San Francisco, the Denver pass rush dialed things up and battered Chargers QB Justin Herbert in this one. The Broncos also came up with a pair of fumble recoveries and an interception on the afternoon. They are a solid unit, but a difficult matchup with the Seahawks awaits the Broncos in Week 6.
